# Light Leak

**Light › Leak** · v1.0.0 · 48 frames at 30 fps (24–120)

Soft, warm light drifts across the frame and floods it, hiding the change, then fades off the new scene.

[Preview video](https://github.com/GTKottman/remotion-transitions/releases/download/media/light-leak@1.0.0.mp4) · [Alpha overlay for editing apps](https://github.com/GTKottman/remotion-transitions/releases/download/media/light-leak@1.0.0-overlay.mov)

## Where it is used

- Weddings and lifestyle
- Nostalgic and film looks
- Music videos

## Use it

```tsx
import { linearTiming, TransitionSeries } from '@remotion/transitions';
import { toPresentation } from './src/core';
import lightLeak from './transitions/09-light/leak/light-leak';

<TransitionSeries.Transition
  presentation={toPresentation(lightLeak, { /* params */ })}
  timing={linearTiming({ durationInFrames: 48 })}
/>
```

Use `linearTiming`: the transition applies its own easing. It draws with WebGL, so render with `--gl=angle` (GPU) or `--gl=swangle` (no GPU).

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Range | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `colors` | colors | `["#FF5A1F","#FFB13B","#FFF1D0"]` |  | Leak colours, from edge to core. |
| `seed` | integer | `1` | 0–9999 | Changes the random layout. |
| `hold` | number | `0.06` | 0–0.3 | Share of the transition at full brightness. |
